description: They built presence outside their own website. One Google #1 client, zero ChatGPT citations. The brands winning AI search played a different game entirely. #AIVisibility #ChatGPT #ContentMarketing #SEO
transcript: Here's a part that should really get your attention. 90% of the pages ChatGPT sites rank 21 or lower on Google. I've seen this firsthand with clients. One brand ranking No. 1 for their main keyword, solid SEO, strong domain authority, zero AI citations because every piece of content they ever produced lived on their own website. They never built presence anywhere else. The brands getting said consistently, different story entirely.
